review_candidates.description: We engage the most inspired minds to do their best work wherever they work best—powering the freedom to create worldwide. WP Engine empowers companies and agencies of all sizes to build, power, manage, and optimize their WordPress websites and applications with confidence. Serving 1.5 million customers across 150+ countries, the global technology company provides premium, enterprise-grade solutions, tools, and services, including specialized platforms for WordPress, industry-tailored eCommerce and agency solution suites, and developer-centric tools like Local, Advanced Custom Fields, and more. WP Engine’s innovative technology and industry-leading expertise are why 8% of the web visits a WP Engine-powered site daily. Learn more at wpengine.com. Job Description In this role, you will architect and implement backend capabilities that drive our global, high-scale cloud infrastructure services.This position transcends standard backend development and pure DevOps; you will operate at the intersection of software engineering, distributed systems, and production reliability, maintaining full ownership of services from initial design through observability and technical support. Your work will focus on complex challenges in resiliency, asynchronous workflows, automation, and system scalability. We value engineers with deep technical fundamentals who are eager to adapt to evolving architectures, new languages, and emerging cloud-native technologies. What's Cool About This Job Build, test, deploy, and maintain backend services and platform capabilities. Develop and integrate APIs using established service and architecture patterns. Work with relational data stores and contribute to reliable data access and service integration patterns. Contribute to event-driven and asynchronous workflows, including message-based processing and background jobs. Run and support services across cloud and platform environments, including managed cloud services, containers, virtual machines, and other runtime models. Use CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code workflows to deliver changes safely and repeatably. Use logs, metrics, and traces to understand application behavior and diagnose production issues. Participate in technical design discussions, ADRs, RFCs, and code reviews, asking questions and contributing practical implementation feedback. Own defined areas of work and collaborate with more experienced engineers on broader architectural or cross-team decisions. Use AI-assisted engineering tools to speed up development, improve testing, explore codebases, and investigate technical problems. Your expertise and passion Backend Engineering: Solid software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience building backend services or web platforms. Go/Python is preferred for many modern platform services, but strong experience with another backend language is equally relevant if you can learn new technologies quickly. Cloud & Platform Engineering: Practical exposure to public cloud or modern platform environments. Experience with either GCP or AWS is valuable. Distributed Systems & Architecture: You should understand the fundamentals of distributed systems and have practical exposure to event-driven systems, asynchronous processing, and scalability. DevOps & Observability: Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and monitoring using logs and metrics to diagnose issues. Security: Familiarity with Identity and Access Management, authentication/authorization fundamentals, and basic cloud security practices. Engineering Practices: Application of sound engineering practices like SOLID principles, automated testing, and technical documentation. AI-Assisted Engineering: Thoughtful use of modern AI tools to accelerate implementation, explore code, and support debugging while maintaining technical ownership. Helpful Experience To Have Languages & Runtimes: Go, PHP, Ruby, Python. Cloud Services: GCP, AWS, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, GKE, EC2, S3. Orchestration & Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform. Observability Tools: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Datadog. Perks And Benefits Company Stock Options (Every employee is an owner in the company) Health Benefits (LuxMed Premium Rehab + Dentistry III) Pension Scheme with a match Life Insurance, 100% premium paid by WP Engine Free Multisport Card - Light and Classic Short-Term Disability & Sick Leave: 100% salary coverage for the first 33 days Employee Assistance Program Generous Vacation Time (Who doesn’t like time off) 1 floating holiday 4 Company Wellness Days Home Office Stipend On-going education through LinkedIn Learning, Workday Learning and our Career Growth Portal At WP Engine, we strive to have the broadest possible view of diversity, going beyond visible differences to include the background, experiences, skills, and perspectives that make each person unique. WP Engine is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law. Base Salary Range zł244,000.00 - zł335,500.00 We believe that compensation should be reflective of the impact you have within the organization relative to the market value of your role. The estimated base salary range for this position is as listed above. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Our salary ranges are determined by job role and responsibilities and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for salaries for the position nationwide. review_candidates.title: Data Scientist
review_candidates.description: Company Description Mona Trading LLC, founded in 1973, has grown from a small regional company into a recognized enterprise serving manufacturing, industrial, oil & gas, and construction sectors across a broad region. The company is known for introducing innovative technologies, ensuring optimal product quality, and delivering comprehensive service. Mona Trading LLC emphasizes ethical business practices and mutual trust in all relationships with clients and suppliers. Team members join a stable, long-standing organization that values professional integrity and long-term partnerships. The company’s diverse customer base and sectors offer exposure to complex, real-world data challenges. Role Description The Data Scientist will be responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing large datasets to generate insights that support business decisions across Mona Trading LLC’s key sectors. Day-to-day tasks include building and validating statistical and machine learning models, designing experiments, and developing dashboards and reports to communicate findings to stakeholders. The role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to identify data-driven opportunities, define metrics, and improve operational efficiency and customer outcomes. The Data Scientist will also help maintain data pipelines, ensure data quality, and document methodologies and results in a clear, accessible format. This is a full-time remote role. Qualifications Strong foundation in Data Science and Data Analytics, with experience applying these skills to business problems. Proficiency in Statistics and Data Analysis for modeling, hypothesis testing, and performance evaluation. Ability to create clear and informative Data Visualization to present complex findings to non-technical stakeholders. Hands-on experience with programming languages commonly used in data science (e.g., Python or R) and data querying tools (e.g., SQL). Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and libraries, and experience deploying models into production environments is an advantage. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a remote setting while collaborating effectively with distributed teams. Experience working with data from industrial, manufacturing, or oil & gas sectors is a plus.

review_candidates.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer (Robotische Manipulatoren) (m/w/d)
review_candidates.description: EvoLogics ist ein innovatives High-Tech-Unternehmen mit Sitz in Berlin. Wir entwickeln und vermarkten weltweit Produkte und Schlüsseltechnologien in der maritimen und Offshore-Technik. Unsere Expertise umfasst die Schwerpunkte Robotik (USV, AUV und ROV), High-Tech-Sensorik, künstliche Intelligenz, fortgeschrittene Informatik, Kommunikationstechnologie sowie Positionierung. Das Unternehmen wurde im Jahr 2000 durch international renommierte Entwicklungsexperten und Wissenschaftler gegründet und ist seitdem kontinuierlich gewachsen. Wir sind stolz auf unsere weltweite Technologieführerschaft für Anwendungen in der Meeresforschung, der smarten Robotik und der maritimen Sicherheit. Der Mitarbeiterstamm rekrutiert sich aus internationalen erfahrenen Fachexperten, Ingenieuren und Software-Entwicklern, die über praktische Expertise und tiefgreifende wissenschaftlich-technische Kompetenzen in den Bereichen Elektronik- und Softwareentwicklung, Robotik und in der Integration komplexer IT-Systeme verfügen. Aufgaben Entwicklung, Implementierung und Optimierung von Echtzeit-Algorithmen zur aktiven Hubkompensation (Active Heave Compensation, AHC) sowie zur 6-DoF-Schiffsbewegungskompensation, um die absolute Stabilität des Endeffektors auch bei rauem Seegang sicherzustellen. Integration von Daten aus Motion Reference Units (MRUs), IMUs und Computer-Vision-Systemen mithilfe fortschrittlicher Filterverfahren (z. B. Kalman-Filter), um dynamische Bewegungen der Trägerplattform vorherzusagen und auszugleichen. Entwicklung und Optimierung von Vorwärts- und Inverskinematik, Trajektorienplanung sowie kollisionsfreier Bewegungsplanung für 6-DoF- und 7-DoF-Roboterarme in beengten und dynamischen Einsatzumgebungen. Entwicklung robuster, produktionsreifer und hochdeterministischer Software in C++ und Python für die Simulationsumgebung von EvoLogics. Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Simulationsumgebungen, welche Wellenphysik, Schiffshydrodynamik und Sensorsignale realitätsnah modellieren, um das Systemverhalten vor Erprobungen auf See zu validieren. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Schiffbauingenieuren, Konstrukteuren und KI-Ingenieuren zur Definition robuster Hardwareanforderungen und der Systemarchitektur. Profil Bachelor-, Master- oder Promotionsabschluss in Robotik, Regelungstechnik, Mechatronik, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet. Mindestens fünf Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Programmierung und Inbetriebnahme von Industrie- oder kollaborativen Roboterarmen, insbesondere im Bereich Kinematik auf bewegten Plattformen oder der Kompensation dynamischer Störungen. Fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Echtzeit-Regelungsverfahren (z. B. Model Predictive Control, adaptive Regelung) sowie der Sensorfusion. Hervorragende Programmierkenntnisse in modernem C++ und Python. Umfangreiche Erfahrung mit ROS/ROS2 sowie Motion-Planning-Frameworks wie MoveIt! und OMPL. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in 3D-Geometrie, Starrkörperdynamik, linearer Algebra und räumlichen Transformationen. Berufserfahrung in der maritimen Industrie, im Offshore- oder Unterwasserbereich, beispielsweise mit ROVs (Remotely Operated Vehicles), USVs (Uncrewed Surface Vehicles) oder Offshore-Hebeanlagen. Kenntnisse maritimer Sicherheitsstandards sowie Erfahrung mit den besonderen Herausforderungen beim Einsatz von Hardware in korrosiven, salzwasserhaltigen Umgebungen mit hohen Vibrationsbelastungen. Erfahrung in der Integration von 2D/3D Bilderkennungssystemen (OpenCV, Point Cloud Library) für sichtgeführte Manipulation während der Bewegung Erfahrung mit Echtzeit Betriebssystemen (RTOS) und embedded C für Ultra-Low Latency Regel- und Steuerkreise Wir bieten Angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld in einem hoch motivierten Team Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit hoher Eigenverantwortung Unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten Attraktives Gehaltspaket inklusive betrieblicher Altersvorsorge Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie regelmäßige Team-Events und Workshops Important note Please be advised that a valid work permit for Germany is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit and sufficient German language skills may not be considered. LNKD1_DE
